snippet.title: Lonely Mountains: Snow Riders - Baifushan - New Mountain Update
snippet.description:
Baifushan is a free update to Lonely Mountains: Snow Riders, available now on Xbox and Steam. It is inspired by the beauty of Chinese mountainscapes and might be the most gorgeous mountain we ever made - it is definitely the biggest. 

Baifushan offers four new trails with two slopes each, new challenges, new achievements, full multiplayer support for racing, team mode, quickmatches, private tours, and leaderboards. We spend a lot of time working on this mountain and we hope you will enjoy it as much as we do.

For everyone who wants to support the ongoing development of Snow Riders we are now offering a supporter customization pack. It doesn’t give you any gameplay advantages but you are getting a whole bunch of awesome gear and accessories together with our eternal gratitude for helping us to keep working on the game

Lonely Mountains: Snow Riders is available on Xbox including Game Pass and Steam!

Get the game now on Xbox and Steam!
Xbox: https://www.xbox.com/en-US/games/store/lonely-mountains-snow-riders/9pf3mc3v9q27
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2545360/Lonely_Mountains_Snow_Riders/

Supporter Pack:
Xbox: https://www.xbox.com/en-US/games/store/lonely-mountains-snow-riders-supporter-pack/9pkj5phq34wm
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3390150/Lonely_Mountains_Snow_Riders__Supporter_Pack/

Join the Lonely Mountains Community on Discord: https://www.discord.gg/lonelymountains
